intro: This edition of The Builder's Brief focuses on the latest advancements in AI models, agents, and research, with a emphasis on practical applications and real-world implications. From explainable reinforcement learning to multimodal LLM systems, we've curated the top 12 articles that matter most to builders.

curated_items.title: Explainable Reinforcement Learning via Physics-Aware Policy Distillation
curated_items.summary: This paper introduces a novel approach to explainable reinforcement learning by leveraging physics-aware policy distillation. The method enables the deployment of deep reinforcement learning in safety-critical sectors.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use this approach to develop more transparent and trustworthy AI systems.

curated_items.title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence
curated_items.summary: Kimi K3 is a 2.8T parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with native vision capabilities and a 1-million-token context window. It is built on Kimi Delta Attention and Attention Residuals.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can leverage Kimi K3 for large-scale language modeling tasks and explore its applications in vision and multimodal domains.

curated_items.title: GPT-Red: Unlocking Self-Improvement for Robustness
curated_items.summary: GPT-Red is an automated red teaming system that uses self-play to improve AI safety, alignment, and prompt injection robustness.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use GPT-Red to develop more robust and secure AI models.

curated_items.title: ClinFusion: A Vision-Centric Multimodal LLM System for Holistic Medical Understanding
curated_items.summary: ClinFusion is a multimodal LLM system designed for holistic medical understanding. It absorbs knowledge from heterogeneous 2D and 3D medical images and aligns evaluation protocols with clinical practice.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use ClinFusion to develop more effective medical diagnosis and treatment systems.

curated_items.title: The Physics of Multi-Turn Long-Horizon Planning
curated_items.summary: This paper explores the physics of multi-turn long-horizon planning, focusing on the acquisition, shaping, and integration of planning ability in foundation models.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use this research to develop more effective planning and decision-making systems.

curated_items.title: moonshotai/Kimi-K3
curated_items.summary: Moonshotai has released the weights for their excellent 2.8 trillion parameter Kimi K3 model.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use Kimi K3 for large-scale language modeling tasks and explore its applications in vision and multimodal domains.

curated_items.title: ERUnderstand: Evaluating Vision-Language Models on Structured ER Diagrams
curated_items.summary: ERUnderstand is a benchmark for evaluating vision-language models on structured ER diagrams, aiming to improve AI-assisted database engineering.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use ERUnderstand to develop more effective database engineering systems.

curated_items.title: DataOrchestra: Learning to Orchestrate Per-Example Curation of Pretraining Data
curated_items.summary: DataOrchestra is a method for learning to orchestrate per-example curation of pretraining data, adapting to the needs of each example.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use DataOrchestra to improve the quality and effectiveness of their pretraining data.

curated_items.title: Co-Learning for Missing Arbitrary Modalities in Multi-modal Classification
curated_items.summary: This paper proposes a co-learning approach for missing arbitrary modalities in multi-modal classification, leveraging complementary information across diverse data sources.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use this approach to develop more robust and effective multi-modal classification systems.

curated_items.title: hkc5/cursor-bridge
curated_items.summary: Cursor-bridge is a Claude Code that runs on your Cursor subscription, providing a seamless integration with the Claude AI model.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use cursor-bridge to develop more effective and integrated AI systems.

curated_items.title: Open-source Cloudflare deployed agent native task management and wiki
curated_items.summary: This project provides an open-source Cloudflare deployed agent with native task management and wiki capabilities.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use this project to develop more effective and integrated agent systems.
